task.ques: On Apple's website, what is the slogan for the Mac and what is the slogan for the Macbook pro.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Mac — “Think different.” MacBook Pro — “Boost mode.”

Evidence: Apple’s Mac page (https://www.apple.com/mac/) displays “Mac” with “Think different.” Apple’s MacBook Pro page (https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/) displays “MacBook Pro” with “Boost mode.” Checked October 27, 2026. The viewport screenshot final.png shows the MacBook Pro name and slogan.
